name: Funding carry — long spot leg (positive funding)
rationale: When perpetual funding is positive, longs pay shorts: the market is positioned net-long and paying a carry premium to shorts. A long spot position held alongside a short perp captures the basis without directional risk (the perp leg is the mirror — see funding-carry-short-perp.json). Standalone, this leg is a funded long: it earns the spot upside and is entered ONLY when funding is above a fitted floor so the carry premium offsets friction. The funding_feature field wires the point-in-time funding rate as P&L accrual on the open position (BIS WP 1087 — documented risk premium, beneath institutional-capacity notice). Entry: funding above a fitted positive floor AND price in an uptrend (trend filter keeps us out of funding-spike-before-crash regime). Exit: funding flips negative (signal_exit) or the stop/TP fires. No magic numbers — every threshold is in param_space.
catalyst: Positive perpetual funding = longs paying a carry premium to shorts; long spot captures upside + accrues the premium.
